'''Saraban City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sibisime]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Zakarisz Ghent]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Handoff">{{GamerCite|10|Handoff|reprint=1}}</ref>
